svg.aria-label: Hardware: Edge: Cisco ISR 4331. Internet link and NAT. Hands traffic to the firewall over a /30 transit link. Firewall: CloudGenix ION 3000. Runs OPNsense: stateful filtering, Suricata IDS, and DHCP for the Guest and camera VLANs. Core: Catalyst 3850-48. Layer 3 switch that routes between VLANs and relays DHCP requests. Access: Catalyst 3850-48. Layer 2 switch for every device, with a 2 × 10G uplink to the core. Compute: Dell PowerEdge R720. Proxmox VE host with dual CPUs and 384 GB of RAM, running six VMs. Storage: UniFi UNAS Pro. Seven-bay storage for backups and file shares. Wireless: Two UniFi access points. One per floor, each with Internal and Guest Wi-Fi and fast roaming. Surveillance: PoE cameras and NVR. Four cameras on their own VLAN, recording to the NVR in the rack. Power: UniFi UPS and rack PDU. Battery backup and power distribution for the whole rack.
svg.title: Hardware
